{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
if data['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any():
    data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
else:
    data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].astype(float)

# Exclude refunded orders and QA test orders (revenue == '999999.99')
completed_only = data[data['status'] == 'completed']
qa_count = (completed_only['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum()
if qa_count > 0:
    completed_only = completed_only[completed_only['revenue'] != '999999.99']

# Verify premises
print(f"Number of QA test orders (revenue == '999999.99'):", qa_count)
print(f"Number of refunded orders:", (data['status'] == 'refunded').sum())

# Compute average revenue per channel, stratified by customer_segment
stratified_avg = completed_only.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue_clean'].mean().unstack(level='channel')

# Extract and print only the exact values needed for evidence
# Print each number as a separate output to ensure it is captured
print(f"email_loyal_avg_revenue: {stratified_avg.loc['loyal', 'email']:.2f}")
print(f"paid_search_loyal_avg_revenue: {stratified_avg.loc['loyal', 'paid_search']:.2f}")
print(f"email_new_avg_revenue: {stratified_avg.loc['new', 'email']:.2f}")
print(f"paid_search_new_avg_revenue: {stratified_avg.loc['new', 'paid_search']:.2f}")
print(f"email_returning_avg_revenue: {stratified_avg.loc['returning', 'email']:.2f}")
print(f"paid_search_returning_avg_revenue: {stratified_avg.loc['returning', 'paid_search']:.2f}")
print(f"email_minus_paid_search_loyal_diff: {stratified_avg.loc['loyal', 'email'] - stratified_avg.loc['loyal', 'paid_search']:.2f}")
print(f"email_minus_paid_search_new_diff: {stratified_avg.loc['new', 'email'] - stratified_avg.loc['new', 'paid_search']:.2f}")
print(f"email_minus_paid_search_returning_diff: {stratified_avg.loc['returning', 'email'] - stratified_avg.loc['returning', 'paid_search']:.2f}")"}
